name: io.github.zerobounce/zerobounce-mcp
title: ZeroBounce
description: Validate, score and find emails, clean lists in bulk, run inbox placement tests and email warmup.

environmentVariables.name: ZEROBOUNCE_WARMUP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ZeroBounce Warmup API key. Optional: enables the Warmup tools (25 tools); without it they are not registered.

environmentVariables.name: ZEROBOUNCE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional ZeroBounce API base URL (defaults to the ZeroBounce production API).
